newsitem.title: USA: CitySearch raises $20 million in venture financing.
newsitem.headline: CitySearch raises $20 million in venture financing.

text.p: On-line information service CitySearch said on Thursday it had raised new venture capital totalling more than $20 million, allowing it to continue its expansion in North America and internationally.

Investors in the current round include Compaq Computer Corp, Comcast Corp, Goldman Sachs, AT&T Co's AT&T Ventures, The Toronto Star, Far West Capital Management, EnCompas Group, Simmons New Media and other unnamed "leading industry players", CitySearch said in a statement.
Bill Gross, whose Idealab venture incubation firm has launched a number of recent Internet startups, has increased his equity position through additional investment, the company said.

CitySearch, whose revenue has been increasing by more than 50 percent per month, is establishing local community guides in metropolitan regions, including San Francisco, Pasadena, New York City and Raleigh-Durham, N.C.
The firm had formed technology, sales and strategic market partnerships with some of the new investors, it said.

"Many of our new investors will lend their expertise as strategic partners, helping create new business opportunities in particular market segments," said chief executive officer Charles Conn. -- Palo Alto Bureau +1 415 846 5400
